infotexts.entitydescription.aegisvacuum: Two-handed suction tool with a replaceable battery. Requires an Aegis salvage backpack in your inventory and LuaCs. Aim and hold use to collect. Press F to open storage. The vacuum battery also powers salvage.
infotexts.entitydescription.aegisvacuumpack: Equip in the belt bag slot. Open contents with Backpack storage [F], the F key or right-clicking the backpack icon. Holds 200 groups of up to 200 actual items and preserves loaded crates. Craft backpack and vacuum separately. The battery belongs in the vacuum.
infotexts.aegisvacuum.title: Aegis vacuum storage
infotexts.aegisvacuum.stackhelp: Take one stack into one inventory slot, using the game stack limit. Tops up an existing stack. Excess stays in the backpack; different quality or condition will not fill more slots.
infotexts.aegisvacuum.filterhelp: Choose YES for the types you want to keep.
infotexts.aegisvacuum.rulehelp.filter: Red marks exclude this item type from automatic pickup.
infotexts.aegisvacuum.rulehelp.protect: Green marks protect this item type from salvaging and trashing.
infotexts.aegisvacuum.rulehelp.allow: Allow pickup and manual insertion of items like detached ore. Access and attachment checks still apply, as does the Ignore rule during pickup.
infotexts.aegisvacuum.allowed: Default filter overridden for this item type.
infotexts.aegisvacuum.included: Pickup enabled. Click to exclude this item type.
infotexts.aegisvacuum.excluded: Excluded from pickup, including inside containers. Click to enable.
infotexts.aegisvacuum.trashhelp: Permanently delete the selected group (or one instance in details), including container contents. First click shows the count; second confirms. Confirmation expires in 10 seconds.
infotexts.aegisvacuum.capacityhelp: Up to 200 groups of 200 items. Items retain condition and quality. The round's entity limit also applies.
infotexts.aegisvacuum.openhelp: Open backpack contents. You can also right-click the backpack icon in the belt slot.
infotexts.aegisvacuum.salvagehelp: Hold the charged vacuum in both hands. Salvage processes the contents present when started. You can keep collecting; new items wait for the next salvage job. Items without supported recipes, requiring special machines or without output space are skipped. Progress and results appear above search.
infotexts.entitydescription.aegiscombattool: Two-handed energy-ring emitter and technical multitool. Slot 1: battery or reactor fuel rod for weapons, shield, flashlight and tools. Slot 2: separately crafted Aegis shield cartridge. Without the cartridge the shield is disabled. The shield blocks five projectiles, deals no contact damage and restores one block per 15 powered seconds. Players disable NPC damage to weld/cut; extinguisher takes priority. Bots choose one function for their current task. Powered use grants +2 to all five skills every five minutes, shared with the composite tool. Requires client and server LuaCs.
infotexts.entitydescription.aegiscompositetool: A composite tool; toggle welder/cutter, shine a built-in flashlight beam, enable extinguisher mode, and use a shared oxygen tank. With a usable fuel rod, holding it grants +2 to all five skills every 5 minutes. Passive training requires Lua for Barotrauma and shares progress with Aegis.
infotexts.entitydescription.aegiswrenchscrewdriver: Designed for submarine engineers, double right-click to switch wrenches/screwdrivers.
infotexts.aegisvacuum.batchhelp: Click several tiles to select them. In group view, take all items in the selected groups; in details, take the selected instances. Items that do not fit stay in the backpack.
infotexts.aegisvacuum.loosehelp: Collect items on the floor, including dropped tools with fuel or ammo inside. Take portable containers intact; never extract their contents. Saved on this backpack.
infotexts.entitydescription.aegisshieldmodule: Craft separately and install in slot 2 of the Aegis combat multitool. Stores five projectile blocks: each blocked projectile spends 20% charge. Recovers one block per 15 powered seconds, so two blocks take 30 seconds and all five take 75 seconds. Recharges only while installed in an intact, powered weapon; removal and saving preserve partial charge. An empty cartridge stays installed. Shield impacts still use weapon power. The shield deals no contact damage.
infotexts.entitydescription.aegisservomodule: Craft separately and install in slot 3 of the Aegis servo suit, after power and ammunition. Enables every arm function: repair, welding, combat and tractor beam. Removing it releases the held target and stops arm work. It does not replace the ammunition box or power source.
infotexts.entitydescription.aegisimpellermodule: Craft separately and install in slot 4 of the Aegis servo suit. Enables the underwater propulsion impeller. Removing it disables powered swimming assistance. Life support, sonar and lights remain independent.
infotexts.label.aegisshieldslot: Shield cartridge: 5 blocks / 15 s per restored block
infotexts.entitydescription.aegisservosuitdescende: Exosuit rated to 10,000 m. Slots: battery, ammunition, servo, impeller, compressor and oxygen tank. The arm, thruster, sonar and light require a battery. The suit draws from the tank underwater. The compressor refills the tank in breathable air. Craft modules separately. Requires client and server LuaCs.

infotexts.aegisvacuum.protecttypehelp: Protects every copy of this item type, including future pickups. Dismantling and trash skip them, including items inside containers.
infotexts.aegisvacuum.collectionhelp: YES: collect this type. NO: skip it during collection and insertion. Does not change dismantling protection.
infotexts.aegisvacuum.unblockhelp: Overrides this type's default collection block. Does not disable dismantling protection.
infotexts.aegisvacuum.ruleshelp: Do not dismantle: YES keeps all current and future copies of that type. Collect independently controls what the backpack accepts. Override is only needed for types blocked by default. Rules are saved in the backpack.
